title: Attachment Styles
summary: Attachment styles describe patterns in how people seek closeness: secure (comfortable with closeness), anxious (fear of abandonment), avoidant (discomfort with closeness) and disorganised.
key_points: Styles can shift with self-awareness and safe relationships.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
